name: Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B Q4_K_M on one Intel Arc Pro B70

library.summary: 35B-class MoE (256 experts / 8 active, arch qwen35moe) topping 100 tok/s on a single card, stock pinned upstream; independent local numbers for the family's external one-card claims.

featured_metric.label: decode (3B active parameters)
featured_metric.scope: Conventional 99-interval median, cold 12-prompt suite, 512-token responses, target-only, cache-zero; second fresh-server run 104.810772.

contributors.name: neural.download lab
contributors.contribution: Intake verification, bring-up, baselines, depth sweep, operating point, canary battery, package.
contributors.validated_effect: Stock-upstream characterization; no lab patches in this package.

contributors.name: unverified external one-B70 performance report
contributors.contribution: Discovery lead that prompted independent local testing of this family.
contributors.validated_effect: None adopted; all published numbers are local measurements.

performance_profiles.label: Raw decode over existing context depth
performance_profiles.scope: llama-bench raw engine rates (pp2048/tg128, fa on, 5 reps). The directly measured zero-depth point remains in the linked raw evidence; no missing depth is interpolated.

performance_profiles.label: Raw pp2048 over existing context depth
performance_profiles.scope: llama-bench raw engine rates (pp2048/tg128, fa on, 5 reps). The directly measured zero-depth point remains in the linked raw evidence; no missing depth is interpolated.

known_limitations: MoE rate reflects ~3B active parameters; not comparable to dense 35B expectations.
Canary battery is objective self-consistency only; no cross-model oracle.
Two-card layer split measured 102.01/102.20 tok/s vs 104.84/104.81 on one card (-2.6%): use one card for single-stream decode.

runtime.build: cmake -G Ninja -B build-sycl-aot-bmg-g31 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=icpx -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=icx -DGGML_SYCL=ON -DGGML_SYCL_F16=ON -DGGML_SYCL_DEVICE_ARCH=bmg_g31 -DGGML_SYCL_MAX_PARALLEL_LINK_JOBS=32 -DLLAMA_CURL=OFF && cmake --build build-sycl-aot-bmg-g31 --target llama-server llama-bench -j 24

commands.launch: BUILD_DIR/bin/llama-server --model $MODEL_DIR/Ornith-1.5-35B-Q4_K_M.gguf --alias ornith35b --reasoning off --ctx-size 8192 --cache-type-k f16 --cache-type-v f16 --device SYCL0 --gpu-layers 99 --flash-attn auto --parallel 1 --cache-ram 0 --ctx-checkpoints 0 --fit off --metrics --no-webui --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18100
commands.benchmark: python3 scripts/bench-openai-realistic-suite.py --base-url http://127.0.0.1:18100 --model ornith35b --api-mode completions --suite repro/qwen36-27b-autoround-int4-b70/realistic-suite-v1.json --max-tokens 512 --metric-tokens 100 --seed 1 --request-extra-json '{"cache_prompt":false,"seed":42,"temperature":0}' --out bench.json
